La experiencia en la confitería fué espantosa. Las mesas grasientas de años, mucha mugre, un asco. Un poco de Cif y ganas. A ponerse las pilas con la limpieza. Como socio del ACÁ me dió vergüenza.

(Translated by Google)
The experience at the confectionery was appalling. The tables were greasy from years of use, filthy, disgusting. A little Cif and some effort would do. They need to get serious about cleaning. As a member of ACA, I was ashamed.
